title: Will Mamdani sign above 0 executive orders between Oct 25, 2026 and Oct 31, 2026?
rules: If the number of non-emergency executive orders signed by Zohran Mamdani is above 0 from Oct 25, 2026 to Oct 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

blind.reasoning: Mamdani signed more than 11 non-emergency executive orders in January, then slowed to occasional orders (e.g., June heat order, July small-business order), suggesting roughly 1-2 per month afterward. At about 0.5 orders per week, the chance of at least one in a given 7-day window is roughly 35-45%. I couldn't confirm any order in or announced for Oct 25-31.
blind.falsifier: An official nyc.gov listing or news report of a numbered, non-emergency Mamdani executive order dated Oct 25-31, 2026 (proving a NO-lean forecast wrong), or confirmation that his post-January pace is much higher than one or two a month.

final.reasoning: The low market price suggests his post-January pace is slower than my rough estimate of 0.5 orders a week, and I couldn't verify recent orders, so I moved down to 20%. That leaves a modest edge resting on thin evidence, so I'm passing.
